scientific_question: Can actual H100 raw CUTLASS FP8 linears alone exceed the H100 planning service ceiling when measured at Gemma's exact fused-linear shapes?
semantics: Checkpoint-free deterministic component proxy; no endpoint throughput, quality, fit, reliability, or FP8 admission claim.

lifecycle.allocation: one preemptible gpu-h100-sxm / 1gpu-16vcpu-200gb plus one 100-GiB network disk
lifecycle.trigger: Only after atomic retrieval of primary stage==primary, terminal.pass, exact H100 identity, gemma4_h100_exact_shape_direct_cutlass_fp8 type, and sentinel.pass, with >=420 seconds remaining. False trigger completes cleanup immediately.
lifecycle.cleanup: One shared VerifiedRetainedOwner/watchdog owns create, retrieval, and authenticated zero instance/disk cleanup. No repair or retained follow-up.

acceptance.sentinel: One separately retrieved M8 sliding-QKV row must pass exact image/source/H100 identity, corrected dual output oracle, positive stable CUDA and synchronized-wall distributions, allocator evidence, and telemetry.
acceptance.sweep: Exactly 24 rows: six exact fused-linear shapes times M8/M16/M32/M3679, each matched to BF16 and recorded with the same dual oracle and timing acceptance.
acceptance.aggregation: For c8/c16/c32, apply layer multiplicity, multiply 358 decode steps, divide decode only by concurrency, and include shared M3679 prefill once.
acceptance.decision: Compare the linear component floor with 0.5479752315195353 s/request. Only a floor above that ceiling falsifies the H100 planning envelope; below ceiling cannot admit FP8 because head, attention/KV, cache writing, quantization, and service overhead are omitted.

prior_boundary: The H100 paged-KV owner terminal was a no-science context-construction failure with authenticated cleanup; it neither triggers this packet nor contributes performance evidence. L40S supplies source/oracle structure only, never timing or economics.
